_comment: Acceptance contract for brain/10-specs/e5-confirm-prompt-field.md. The agent may ONLY flip 'passes'. Entries may never be added, removed, or reworded. Written 2026-09-19.

features.description: A record-defined tool with a template renders it, with the call's arguments substituted, as the question body — no JSON dump.
A tool with both a code callable and a record template uses the callable.
A tool with neither renders the JSON dump exactly as today.
A template that raises falls back to the JSON dump; the run still pauses and the question is still asked.
A template naming an argument the call did not supply falls back to the JSON dump rather than showing a blank where a value belongs.
A template cannot execute code or reach out of its sandbox: an attribute-escape attempt renders nothing dangerous and falls back.
A template whose text resembles a file path is rendered as text, not loaded from disk.
The first line uses the tool's human title when it has one, and the slug when it does not.
Options are exactly [Approve, Deny] and allow_other is unchanged, for every case above.
Only the exact answer Approve executes the tool, for a templated tool as for any other.
Upstream's TestAgentConfirmation stays green and unmodified.
